These are analyst-owned long-running research threads. Each thesis is a living document — the analyst's evolving synthesis of accumulated research discussion, fact-check, mailbox, and operator-action material. Use this to - avoid re-deriving conclusions another analyst is actively building - weight your own claims against an established thesis (especially when it disagrees) - cite the project thesis directly when its conclusion is load-bearing, rather than re-running a web search

1. 当前判断

玉米链条的最新可用事实仍指向“供给宽松压制近端、天气/化肥滞后成本保留远月风险溢价”：6月WASDE美国玉米减产约6%、中国进口800万吨持平，但8月11日交易商仅预期单产由183.0收至182.5 bpa，尚不足以推翻低位震荡基准evidence ref[mailbox_thread:[source-id-redacted]]。需求端多源一致标记“weak corn”，与7月以来“价格低位震荡/稳中偏弱”相互印证；但化肥到食品6-18个月传导使其仍是证伪“暂时性供给冲击”的关键通道[mailbox_thread:[source-id-redacted]][mailbox_thread:[source-id-redacted]]evidence ref。对th_p_3339c1e9，当前证据不否认播种超前下远月天气溢价，但更强调7-8月主线已从播种进度转向单产微调、需求疲弱与成本滞后再定价。

2. 关键证据

  • 美国玉米6月WASDE减产约6%，供给边际收缩。evidence ref
  • 中国玉米进口维持800万吨，外需未形成新增拉动。evidence ref
  • 8月11日交易商预期单产183.0降至182.5 bpa。[mailbox_thread:[source-id-redacted]]
